mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.perms FROM sys_menu m JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.id = rm.menu_id JOIN sys_person_role pr ON rm.role_id = pr.role_id WHERE pr.person_id = #{personId} AND m.type = 'BUTTON' AND m.perms IS NOT NULL

SELECT m.path FROM sys_menu m JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.id = rm.menu_id JOIN sys_person_role pr ON rm.role_id = pr.role_id WHERE pr.person_id = #{personId} AND m.type = 'MENU' AND m.path IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.path ORDER BY MAX(m.sort)
SELECT r.id FROM sys_role r JOIN sys_person_role pr ON r.id = pr.role_id WHERE pr.person_id = #{personId}
SELECT r.name FROM sys_role r JOIN sys_person_role pr ON r.id = pr.role_id WHERE pr.person_id = #{personId} ORDER BY r.sort

SELECT m.perms AS code, m.name AS name, SUBSTRING_INDEX(m.perms, ':', 1) AS module FROM sys_menu m JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.id = rm.menu_id JOIN sys_person_role pr ON rm.role_id = pr.role_id WHERE pr.person_id = #{personId} AND m.type = 'BUTTON' AND m.perms IS NOT NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO sys_person_role (person_id, role_id) VALUES (#{personId}, #{roleId})
